subject: Tata Sierra vs Hyundai Creta
_angle: OPT3 · Same money, different vibe — price parity hook, feature-for-feature, punchy; calm delivery

segments.text: Eleven lakh gets you the nation's darling Creta — or the legend reborn, the Sierra.
The Sierra flexes: a hundred-sixty turbo, a panoramic roof, thirteen-speaker JBL.
The Creta counters: ventilated seats, wireless charging, and a bulletproof reputation.
New-age drama, or safe-bet sense? Smash like for your pick.
Sierra or Creta? One or two in the comments. Like, share, and subscribe.
